pep_population.long_name: Resident population estimate by age group and sex
pep_population.short_description: July 1 resident population estimate by 5-year age group (under 25) and sex.
pep_population.long_description: Census Bureau Population Estimates Program (PEP) July 1 resident population estimates for counties, states, and the nation, by sex and 5-year age group (0-4, 5-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24) plus an all-ages total (age = Overall). Years 2010-2019 come from Vintage 2019 and 2020-2023 from Vintage 2023, so a small discontinuity is expected at the 2019/2020 boundary (Vintage 2023 is rebased to the 2020 Census). Intended as a denominator for age- and sex-specific rates. Sex = Overall is the sum of Male and Female.
pep_population.statement: In {location}, the estimated population in this group was {value} in {time}.

census_pep.name: Census Bureau Population Estimates Program (PEP)
census_pep.location: Census Data API: pep/charagegroups (2019) and pep/charv (2023)
census_pep.description: Annual July 1 resident population estimates produced by the Census Bureau from the most recent decennial census, adjusted for births, deaths, and migration. Retrieved through the Census Data API: Vintage 2019 (pep/charagegroups) for 2010-2019 and Vintage 2023 (pep/charv) for 2020-2023. Only age groups under 25 and the all-ages total are retained. Connecticut county-equivalents follow the codes used by each vintage; Puerto Rico and other territories are excluded. Estimates before 2010 are not available through this API.
census_pep.restrictions: Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

_catalog.name: Census Bureau Population Estimates Program (PEP)
_catalog.summary: Annual July 1 resident population estimates from the Census Bureau Population Estimates Program for the nation, states, and counties (2010-2023), by sex and 5-year age group under 25. Used as the age- and sex-specific denominator for rates such as youth traffic fatality rates.
